definitions.name: N
definitions.source_text: let N[p in patch, a in age] = S[p,a] + E[p,a] + I[p,a] + R[p,a]

definitions.name: N_total
definitions.source_text: let N_total[p in patch]     = sum(a in age, N[p, a])

definitions.name: I_total
definitions.source_text: let I_total[p in patch]     = sum(a in age, I[p, a])

tables.source_text:
C : age × age = [[18.0,  6.0, 1.0],   # child mixes heavily with children
                   [ 6.0, 12.0, 2.0],   # adults: moderate mixing across groups
                   [ 1.0,  2.0, 5.0]]

transitions.name: infection
transitions.source_text:
infection[p in patch, a in age] : S[p, a] --> E[p, a]
    @ S[p, a] * (
        beta_local  * sum(b in age, C[a, b] * I[p, b] / N_total[p])
      + beta_travel * sum(q in patch, adj[p, q] * I_total[q] / N_total[q])
      )

transitions.name: progression
transitions.source_text: progression[p in patch, a in age] : E[p, a] --> I[p, a]  @ sigma * E[p, a]

transitions.name: recovery
transitions.source_text: recovery[p in patch, a in age]    : I[p, a] --> R[p, a]  @ gamma * I[p, a]

transitions.name: aging
transitions.source_text:
aging[c in compartments, p in patch, (a, a_next) in consecutive(age)] : c[p, a] --> c[p, a_next]
    @ (1 / age_dur[a]) * c[p, a]

transitions.name: death
transitions.source_text:
death[c in compartments, p in patch, a in age] : c[p, a] -->
    @ mu * c[p, a]

transitions.name: birth
transitions.source_text:
birth[p in patch] : --> S[p, child]
    @ mu * N_total[p]

initial.source_text: S[p in patch, a in age] = pop_pa[p, a]

scenarios.name: baseline
